label: LIFE KALENDAR
title: The year in dots
on your phone screen
lead: A wallpaper that fills in one more day of the year on its own, every day. No network, no ads, nothing extra.

features.d: A new day appears on the wallpaper every midnight.
Light by day and dark by night: follows the system or your own schedule.
Three themes, three sizes, the grid below the clock, centered or at the bottom.
No internet, no accounts. The app sends nothing anywhere.

steps.d: Download the APK and open it on your phone.
Pick a theme, a size and a place on the screen.
Tap “Set wallpaper” and the rest happens on its own.
